sections.description: Scribe tutorials in the WordPress dashboard with per-site settings.
sections.changelog:
= 1.0.3 =
* Match Scribe embed sizing and default loading behavior while retaining an accessible frame title.

= 1.0.2 =
* Keep tutorial settings in the admin submenu and remove the duplicate link above the embed.

= 1.0.1 =
* Accept organization-prefixed Scribe share links.

= 1.0.0 =
* Initial reusable Scribe tutorials page, dashboard shortcut, per-site settings, and MTT update integration.
